critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:858 delete_many({'quote_id':..., 'status':{'$ne':'done'}}) — correct for the new fix, but note that partial-done states like 'on_the_way' and 'cleaning' will also be replaced when the admin re-assigns. This is likely intended (active work-in-progress can be reassigned), but if the current cleaner has already checked in as 'cleaning', they lose that job silently with no notification. Consider a soft-reassign warning or preserving in-progress records too.

frontend admin.js:47-48 loadAssignments picks 'active over done' per quote_id, but if there are two active records (edge case that can occur if delete_many mid-flight races with insert_one), only the last-iterated wins non-deterministically because forEach order depends on Mongo sort order. Consider explicit priority: assigned > cleaning > on_the_way > done, and log an anomaly if > 1 active exists per quote_id.

LeadCard.js:118 conditional `{!assignment || isDone}` renders the assign button both when there is no assignment AND when it is done. That is correct today, but the button label 'Assign again' is only fired when isDone; if a future 'cancelled' status is added, the label logic in line 121 will need updating (same drift risk noted for STATUS_META keys in iter 10 carry-over).

backend/server.py the new create_assignment behavior means /api/assignments will grow unbounded per quote (every re-completion adds a done record forever). Consider a soft cap or a 'history/{quote_id}' endpoint + auto-archival policy (e.g., keep last N done per quote).

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Both the refactor and the new fix work end-to-end. RCA context for the NEW FIX (for reference): before the fix, create_assignment used delete_many({quote_id:...}) with no status filter, so re-assigning the same quote wiped the historical done record. The one-line change to delete_many({quote_id:..., status:{$ne:'done'}}) preserves history; the frontend then had to render done records (previously excluded because loadAssignments picked at-most-1 record per quote_id — the fix in admin.js:40-53 keeps ALL records in assignmentList for the DailySummary and prefers active-over-done in the assignments map for LeadCard, so LeadCard.js can show the 'Completed' pill + 'Assign again' button when only a done record remains, or the active pill when both exist.
